title: ui_hide
summary: MSUI now implements TOGGLEUI as a rebindable Interface command whose shipped chord is exact ALT-Z. It edge-toggles a world-session UiHidden-equivalent state, suppresses the complete player-HUD draw/input surface while producers and keyboard gameplay continue, preserves bare Z for sheath/unsheath, and clears the hidden state when world feedback resets.

openItems.text: No ALT-Z/TOGGLEUI binding to hide every player-UI surface at once (bars, frames, chat, plates, floating text) while world rendering, keyboard input, and UI state production continue - the screenshot-mode behavior the reference ships.
openItems.resolution: 2026-08-22: GameBinding.ToggleUi ships as exact ALT-Z (and displays/rebinds as Alt plus its bound key); UiHideLaw rejects extra modifiers, repeats, and typing capture. DrawCombatHud returns before every player-UI producer draw while underlying state keeps updating, and ResetCombatFeedback restores visibility on world-session exit. Bare Z remains sheath/unsheath and consumes the physical edge so releasing Alt first cannot create a false sheath press.

openItems.text: Live verify exact ALT-Z toggling in-world: all player UI and custom hover art disappear without losing open-window/chat/cooldown state, invisible UI takes no mouse clicks, gameplay keys remain live, bare Z still sheaths, and logout/re-entry restores visible UI.
